arxiv-2012-14014.title: Cayley-Hamilton Theorem for Symplectic
arxiv-2012-14014.creator: Quantum Matrix Algebras
arxiv-2012-14014.description: Abstract Abstract We establish the analogue of the Cayley–Hamilton theorem for the quantum matrix algebras of the symplectic type. 1 Introduction Let V be a vector space equipped with a bilinear nondegenerate (symmetric or antisymmetric) form. The Brauer algebra [ Br ] generalizes the tower of the centralizing algebras which appears in the Brauer–Schur–Weyl duality, related to V .

arxiv-2102-04585.title: Broadband RF Phased Array Design with MEEP: Comparisons to Array Theory in Two and Three Dimensions
arxiv-2102-04585.creator: Jordan C. Hanson
arxiv-2102-04585.description: Abstract Phased array radar systems have a wide variety of applications in engineering and physics research. Phased array design usually requires numerical modeling with expensive commercial computational packages. Using the open-source MIT Electrogmagnetic Equation Propagation (MEEP) package, a set of phased array designs is presented.

arxiv-2103-11227.title: Spectrally Simple Zeros of Zeon Polynomials
arxiv-2103-11227.creator: G. Stacey Staples
arxiv-2103-11227.description: Abstract Combinatorial properties of zeons have been applied to graph enumeration problems, graph colorings, routing problems in communication networks, partition-dependent stochastic integrals, and Boolean satisfiability. Power series of elementary zeon functions are naturally reduced to finite sums by virtue of the nilpotent properties of zeons.

arxiv-2106-12630.title: Time–dependent Hamilton–Jacobi equations on networks
arxiv-2106-12630.creator: Antonio Siconolfi
arxiv-2106-12630.description: Abstract . We study well posedness of time–dependent Hamilton–Jacobi equations on a network, coupled with a continuous initial datum and a flux limiter. We show existence and uniqueness of solutions as well as stability properties. The novelty of our approach is that comparison results are proved linking the equation to a suitable semidiscrete problem, bypassing doubling variable method.

arxiv-2301-11010.title: On the Optimal Beamwidth of UAV-Assisted Networks Operating at Millimeter Waves
arxiv-2301-11010.creator: Manishika Rawat 1 , Marco Giordani 1 , Brejesh Lall 2 , Abdelaali Chaoub 3 , and Michele Zorzi 1
arxiv-2301-11010.description: Abstract The millimeter-wave (mm-wave) bands enable very large antenna arrays that can generate narrow beams for beamforming and spatial multiplexing. However, directionality introduces beam misalignment and leads to reduced energy efficiency. Thus, employing the narrowest possible beam in a cell may not necessarily imply maximum coverage.

arxiv-2309-02245.title: Simulating quantum backflow on a quantum computer
arxiv-2309-02245.creator: Arseni Goussev, Jaewoo Joo
arxiv-2309-02245.description: Abstract Quantum backflow is a counterintuitive effect in which the probability density of a free particle moves in the direction opposite to the particle’s momentum. If the particle is electrically charged, then the effect can be viewed as the contrast between the direction of electric current and that of the momentum.

arxiv-2402-14585.title: Bandits with Abstention under Expert Advice
arxiv-2402-14585.creator: Stephen Pasteris, Alberto Rumi, Maximilian Thiessen, Shota Saito, Atsushi Miyauchi Fabio Vitale Mark Herbster
arxiv-2402-14585.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Stephen Pasteris, Alberto Rumi, Maximilian Thiessen, Shota Saito, Atsushi Miyauchi Fabio Vitale Mark Herbster. We study the classic problem of prediction with expert advice under bandit feedback. Our model assumes that one action, corresponding to the learner’s abstention from play, has no reward or loss on every trial. We propose the confidence-rated bandits with abstentions ( CBA ) algorithm, which exploits this assumption to obtain reward bounds that can significantly improve those of the classical Exp4 algorithm.

arxiv-2404-04704.title: INR-TH-2024-004 Dark photon emission in elastic proton bremsstrahlung
arxiv-2404-04704.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by *. We study the production of dark photons with masses in range 0.4-1.5 GeV in elastic proton bremsstrahlung. In contrast to the known approaches to calculating the bremsstrahlung cross section, we consider the non-zero momentum transfer between protons. The numerical estimates show that the refined result agrees well with the generalized Weizsacker-Williams approximation, although it significantly differs from the result obtained by Blumlein and Brunner [ 1 ] which is widely used in proton beam-dump phenomenology.

arxiv-2412-06695.title: Towards Brain Passage Retrieval
arxiv-2412-06695.creator: Niall Mcguire, Yashar Moshfeghi
arxiv-2412-06695.description: Abstract . Information Retrieval (IR) systems primarily rely on users’ ability to translate their internal information needs into (text) queries. However, this translation process is often uncertain and cognitively demanding, leading to queries that incompletely or inaccurately represent users’ true needs.

arxiv-2508-19798.title: FusionSort: Enhanced Cluttered Waste Segmentation with Advanced Decoding and Comprehensive Modality Optimization Thanks: The authors would like to thank MBZUAI for providing the computational resources used in this research. We also gratefully acknowledge the Multispectral Waste (MSWaste) dataset te
arxiv-2508-19798.creator: 1 st Muhammad Ali, 2 nd Omar Ali AlSuwaidi
arxiv-2508-19798.description: Abstract In the realm of waste management, automating the sorting process for non-biodegradable materials presents considerable challenges due to the complexity and variability of waste streams. To address these challenges, we introduce an enhanced neural architecture that builds upon an existing Encoder-Decoder structure to improve the accuracy and efficiency of waste sorting systems.

pmc-12465303.title: Prevalence of the QT interval prolongation and its risk factors in hospitalized geriatric patients: findings of a single center cross-sectional study in Pakistan
pmc-12465303.creator: Huma Tanveer, Muhammad Ashfaq, Muhammad Junaid Hassan Sharif, Muhammad Mamoon Iqbal, Ayesha Iqbal, Qasim Khan, Muhammad Zeeshan Haroon, Adel Bashatah, Wajid Syed, Naji Alqahtani
pmc-12465303.description: Background and objectivesGeriatric inpatients are particularly susceptible to Torsades de Pointes (TdP) because they are usually polymorbid and often take QT-prolonging drugs. Since polypharmacy is common in hospitalized geriatrics, it may lead to QT-prolonging Drug-Drug interactions, resulting in adverse cardiac events.

pmc-12471540.title: Overview of Primary and Secondary Metabolites of Rugulopteryx okamurae Seaweed: Assessing Bioactivity, Scalability, and Molecular Mechanisms
pmc-12471540.creator: Ana Minerva García-Cervantes, José A M Prates, José Luis Guil-Guerrero, Carlos Cardoso, Cláudia Afonso, Anatolii I Usov
pmc-12471540.description: Rugulopteryx okamurae is an invasive brown alga that has colonised Mediterranean and northeastern Atlantic coastlines, posing significant ecological and economic challenges. Its biomass is rich in structurally diverse metabolites—including polysaccharides (alginate, fucoidan, laminaran), phlorotannins, diterpenoids, fatty acids, and peptides—many of which exhibit notable antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and anticancer activities.

pmc-12663765.title: Lymphocytic Interstitial Pneumonia Presenting With Haemoptysis and a Solitary Spiculated Pulmonary Nodule: A Case Report
pmc-12663765.creator: Xiao‐Mei Zhong, Hui‐Ming Yin, Cheng Jiang, Jie Lin, Feng‐Yang Han, Jian‐Ming Lei
pmc-12663765.description: Lymphocytic interstitial pneumonia (LIP) is a rare disorder that typically presents with cystic changes on computed tomography. We report a distinctive case of a 53‐year‐old man with LIP whose sole presenting symptom was haemoptysis. Imaging revealed a solitary spiculated pulmonary nodule, highly suspicious for malignancy. Diagnosis was confirmed by surgical resection and histopathology, which demonstrated characteristic diffuse lymphoplasmacytic infiltration.

pmc-13002723.title: Retraction Note: Letrozole versus clomiphene citrate for superovulation in Egyptian women with unexplained infertility: a randomized controlled trial
pmc-13002723.creator: Moustafa I Ibrahim, Rowaa A Moustafa, Ahmed A Abdel-Azeem
pmc-13002723.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). tandard Deviations and p-values reported. pmc-13128508.title: Cavernous Sinus Cavernous Angioma Presenting As Painful Ophthalmoplegia: Report of a Rare Case Involving the Skull Base
pmc-13128508.creator: Rodrigo Furlan Silva Fabri, Rodolfo Myronn De Melo Rodrigues, Anvitha Soundararajan
pmc-13128508.description: Cavernous sinus cavernous angiomas, also termed cavernous hemangiomas, are rare extra-axial vascular malformations with imaging and operative features that differ substantially from intraparenchymal cavernomas. Their presentation frequently mimics more common parasellar tumors, including meningiomas and schwannomas, rendering preoperative diagnosis difficult. These lesions are characteristically highly vascular, compressible, and prone to significant intraoperative hemorrhage.

pmc-13264453.title: Artificial Intelligence for Regulatory Evidence: A Systematic Document Analysis of European Medicines Agency Regulatory Advice and Public Reports
pmc-13264453.creator: Lucina‐May Nollen, Gerard J.P. van Westen, Gabriel Westman, Anna M.G. Pasmooij
pmc-13264453.description: Artificial intelligence (AI) is receiving increasing attention across the entire lifecycle of medicines, from early development to postauthorization use. While various AI tools have been developed in commercial and academic settings, the extent of their use in regulatory contexts within the European Union remains unknown.

pmc-13461153.title: CRISPR screening identifies DTX4 governing alveolar macrophage cholesterol efflux in pulmonary alveolar proteinosis
pmc-13461153.creator: Zimu Wang, Jingwei Shi, Xu Ye, Xinye Xia, Huihui Zhu, Qi Li, Min Chen, Yichao Zhao, Yingwei Zhang, Mengshu Cao, Yonglong Xiao, Xinmei Huang
pmc-13461153.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Pulmonary alveolar proteinosis (PAP) is a rare pulmonary syndrome characterized by impaired surfactant clearance, driven by dysfunctional cholesterol efflux in alveolar macrophages (AMs). However, the molecular determinants governing AM cholesterol homeostasis remain incompletely defined. Here, through a genome-wide CRISPR screen in foamy macrophages and bulk RNA sequencing of AMs from PAP patients, we identify DTX4 as a pivotal regulator of cholesterol efflux in AMs.

pmc-13499172.title: Endovascular management of splenic artery aneurysm with arteriovenous fistula using dual microcatheter embolization
pmc-13499172.creator: Dora Z Zatyko, Ponraj Chinnadurai, Anish Tayal, Brianna E Whithorn, Orlando M Diaz, Alan B Lumsden
pmc-13499172.description: Splenic artery aneurysm with arteriovenous fistula is rare and technically challenging, particularly in the setting of marked tortuosity and high-flow shunting. We report the case of a 69-year-old woman treated with a fully endovascular approach guided by intraoperative cone-beam computed tomography.

pmc-13620314.title: Unravelling therapeutic resistance: role of cancer stem cell and microRNA in metastatic prostate cancer
pmc-13620314.creator: Hitakshi Moondra, Gautam Ram Choudhary, Dinesh Kumar Ahirwar, Mithu Banerjee, Surendra Kumar Shukla, Kamla Kant Shukla
pmc-13620314.description: Metastatic prostate cancer (PCa) is one of the leading causes of cancer-related deaths in men globally. This is largely attributable to the occurrence of therapeutic resistance that reduces the efficacy of the traditional treatment, such as Androgen deprivation therapy, chemotherapy, and radiotherapy.
